**Glowing eyes.** Monsters whose artwork already hints at it now have eyes
that glow in the dark: the zombies' and imp's red, the demon's yellow, the
cacodemon's and mancubus's green, the arachnotron's blue, the pain
elemental's pupil and the spider mastermind's red. The eyes are found in the
sprites themselves when they load, so they work in any WAD that paints its
monsters' eyes that way. They shine whatever light falls on the monster and
get a little bloom (with **Emissive textures** on). Only living monsters
looking your way show them; corpses don't. A spectre's eyes show faintly
through its fuzz. Turn them off in **F4 → Glow → Glowing eyes**.

**README.** The project page now opens with what this is meant to be: DOOM as
it might have looked if its engine had kept evolving and we still played on
CRTs. It also describes the music synths, the bake's light direction and
flicker groups, and the Performance switches that move per-frame light work
into the bake.
